scope: Explicit Kokkos execution for both equation systems and both Krylov methods; performance study precedes new physical targets
default_preservation: Unchanged reference defaults: archived full states, work counts and BY trace remain bit-identical on the original compiler/platform. Perlmutter reference is rebuilt from the frozen commit with the same compiler flags as its CPU candidate.

performance.case: moderate generic unequal mass .6/.4 binary, centers +/-3, frozen free data; computational matching does not equate physical accuracy
performance.preconditioner: same modal FD approximation within each equation system
performance.ordering: interleaved forward/reverse variants and methods, sequential fresh workers; no concurrent numerical contexts
performance.measurements: runtime initialization, setup+solve, solve, first sample, ready-to-sample; fenced A/M/linear/setup/transfer phases; work counts; host RSS and logical resident/workspace device allocations, with actual GPU memory telemetry when available
performance.shared_resource: Perlmutter shared_interactive one GPU fraction node; record Slurm allocation, affinity, hardware identity/memory, software flags and image/source hashes
performance.capacity_change: The explicit maximum budget is extended8192 to65536MiB without changing allocation formulas or numerical arithmetic. The frozen reference receives only this declared guard-cap patch; both variants request32768MiB. Preserve the original8192MiB rejection at128x256x28/restart64.

numerical.original_full_state_bounds: Retain the prior max |delta|/(1+|reference|) <=1e-10 core and coefficient gates, including failures; no GPU or weak-mode waiver
numerical.physical_H_M_difference: max(1e-7,5*corresponding largest independent Cartesian finite-difference step variation)
numerical.stopping: recompute true inner residual and native outer residual; finite states, no failures or silent fallback
numerical.controls: independent nonsymmetric matrices, polynomial/constant/Nyquist spectral derivatives, original coordinate chain, manufactured block inverse, malformed options/failure controls, complete binary states and physical sampling

physical_followup.order: Only after measured performance report is written, opened and successfully compiled in native LaTeX editor
physical_followup.cases: Separate equal-rest-mass aligned seed chi=.99 and nonspinning inward head-on input Gamma=10 cases, as selected by user
physical_followup.separation: Head-on d about50 times the measured one-hole M_irr=sqrt(A/(16*pi)); report attained ratio and calibrate d, not total ADM mass. Search individual and common horizons.
physical_followup.spin: Seed rest |S|/m^2 and measured coordinate horizon spin are distinct
physical_followup.gates: Fresh isolated seed tests, >=3 grids, independent exterior H/M RMS1e-6/max1e-4 and raw-decrease gates, charges/covariance, initial-time AthenaK import/horizons and modified-region enclosure; keep failures explicitly failed
